title: Pocketwire Business Profile Refund Timing Credit Percentages
content:
The refund timing percentage on a Pocketwire Business Profile refund depends on how many calendar days after the sale the refund is dated:

| Refund dated after the sale date | Refund timing percentage |
|---|---|
| no more than 14 calendar days | 100 percent |
| more than 14 but no more than 60 calendar days | 60 percent |
| more than 60 calendar days | 25 percent |

**Formal statement.** The refund timing percentage is 25 percent when the refund is dated more than 60 calendar days after the sale, 60 percent when it is dated more than 14 but no more than 60 calendar days after the sale, and 100 percent when it is dated no more than 14 calendar days after the sale. The count is the number of calendar days from the sale date recorded on the sale to the date recorded on the refund.

## Boundary days

| Refund dated | Percentage |
|---|---|
| 14 days after the sale | 100 percent |
| 15 days after the sale | 60 percent |
| 60 days after the sale | 60 percent |
| 61 days after the sale | 25 percent |

**Illustration (hypothetical dates).** Sale on 1 June, refund on 20 June: 19 days, 60 percent.
